about: QA 1.58.0 LOW-V5: "auto" needs the record's "origin":{"kind":"task-notification"}, which Claude Code writes on the prompts it injects; the same text typed or pasted by the user (no origin, or another kind) is a plain chapter: shown, counted, its own title, no summary; a queued_command carries its mark in the attachment: commandMode "task-notification" (older versions: only that) or its own origin is auto, commandMode "prompt" is a plain chapter; #222: a queued prompt whose "prompt" is a list of text and pasted image blocks is one chapter as a user record's content array is (its text blocks joined, its images riding with it; --chapter shows the text, text blocks joined by a newline), an empty list makes none
